newsitem.title: USA: Ecopetrol tenders to sell Dec South Blend crude.
newsitem.headline: Ecopetrol tenders to sell Dec South Blend crude.

text.p: Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol is seeking bids from a select group of refiners for one cargo of South Blend crude, traders said Tuesday.
The cargo of 400,000 barrels is scheduled for delivery on the Pacific side of Colombia before December 10, with bids due Nov.15.
South Blend crude is notionally priced at $2.70 a barrel discount against West Texas Intermediate.
Equity producers Total Petroleum and British Petroleum are also seeking bids for Cusiana and Vasconia crude, respectively.
The Cusiana cargo is for December 16-20, with Total asking around 45 cents premium to WTI, traders said.
Vasconia was notionally pegged at WTI minus $1.80-$2.00 a barrel.
A U.S. refiner is also looking to buy a spot Cusiana cargo for late December at WTI plus $1.00, trade sources said.
